msgs.text: Quick update on tonight's book signing. Ms. Petrova just called. Her train has been stopped outside Dunmere for over an hour, so she won't get here until about 7:15.
But the signing starts at 6:30, and we've sold more than eighty tickets.
I know. Tunde, could you e-mail all the ticket holders this afternoon and tell them we'll now begin at 7:30?
Sure. I'll put the new time on our Web site, too.
Good point. Mei, could you still open the reading corner at 6:30 and serve coffee and pastries to anyone who comes before Ms. Petrova does?
Of course. The pastries are being delivered at five, so that's no problem.
One more thing. A few customers have asked whether they can buy signed copies without attending.
Ms. Petrova has agreed to sign extra copies after the event. Make a list of their names, and we'll hold the books at the front counter.
I'll put up a sign by the register so people know.

questions.q: What are the writers mainly discussing?
options: A change to a store's opening hours
The cost of tickets for an event
A delay affecting a scheduled event
A problem with a food delivery
questions.explanation: 定位：1:05 Calvo 說作者的火車停在 Dunmere 外面一個多小時，要到 7:15 左右才會到；之後的訊息都在處理簽書會延後的安排（通知購票的人、招待提早到的人、想買簽名書的客人），故 (C) 正確。(A)錯：改的是簽書會的開始時間，不是書店的營業時間。(B)錯：1:08 只提到已經賣出八十多張票，沒有討論票價。(D)錯：1:19 Takahashi 說點心五點會送到，送貨沒有問題。

questions.q: What does Ms. Calvo ask Mr. Bakare to do?
options: Pick up Ms. Petrova at the station
Order more copies of the book
questions.explanation: 定位：1:10 Calvo 寫「Tunde, could you e-mail all the ticket holders this afternoon and tell them we'll now begin at 7:30?」，請他寫信通知所有購票的人，也就是聯絡買了票的人，故 (A) 正確。(B)錯：作者自己搭火車來，沒有人提到要去車站接她。(C)錯：對話沒有提到要多訂書。(D)錯：請人在 6:30 照常開放閱讀區，是 1:17 Calvo 對 Takahashi 的請求，不是對 Bakare。

questions.q: At 1:15 P.M., what does Ms. Takahashi most likely mean when she writes, "Not everyone checks e-mail, though"?
options: She has not received an e-mail from the author.
She thinks the store's Web site is out of date.
She wants Mr. Bakare to send the message twice.
She expects some guests to arrive at 6:30 anyway.
questions.explanation: 定位：Bakare 說要寄信通知並在網站公告新時間後，Takahashi 寫「Not everyone checks e-mail, though」（不過不是每個人都會看電子郵件）；1:17 Calvo 回「Good point」，並請她 6:30 照常開放閱讀區，招待在作者到達之前就來的人。可知她擔心有些客人沒看到通知，仍會照原本的 6:30 到場，故 (D) 正確。(A)錯：作者是打電話來，她說的 e-mail 指的是要寄給購票者的通知信。(B)錯：她沒有評論網站的內容。(C)錯：她沒有要求重寄，Calvo 接著安排的是現場招待。

questions.q: What is indicated about Ms. Petrova?
options: She plans to arrive before the original start time.
She has agreed to sign books for people not attending.
She asked the store to serve coffee and pastries.
She will be speaking at another store later tonight.
questions.explanation: 定位：1:24 Bakare 說有客人想買簽名書但不來參加活動；1:27 Calvo 回「Ms. Petrova has agreed to sign extra copies after the event」，並請他記下這些客人的名字、把書保留在櫃台，可知作者答應替不來參加的人簽書，故 (B) 正確。(A)錯：1:05 說她 7:15 左右才會到，晚於原訂的 6:30。(C)錯：咖啡和點心是 Calvo 請 Takahashi 招待的，不是作者要求的。(D)錯：對話沒有提到她今晚還要去別家書店。

translation:
Rosa Calvo（下午 1:05）
跟大家更新一下今晚簽書會的狀況。Petrova 女士剛剛打電話來，她的火車在 Dunmere 外面停了一個多小時，所以她大概要到 7:15 才會到。

Tunde Bakare（下午 1:08）
可是簽書會 6:30 就開始了，而且我們已經賣出八十多張票。

Rosa Calvo（下午 1:10）
我知道。Tunde，你今天下午可以寫電子郵件給所有購票的人，告訴他們活動改成 7:30 開始嗎？

Tunde Bakare（下午 1:12）
沒問題。我也會把新的時間公告在我們的網站上。

Mei Takahashi（下午 1:15）
不過不是每個人都會看電子郵件。

Rosa Calvo（下午 1:17）
說得對。Mei，你可以照樣在 6:30 開放閱讀區，請在 Petrova 女士到達之前就來的人喝咖啡、吃點心嗎？

Mei Takahashi（下午 1:19）
當然可以。點心五點會送到，所以沒問題。

Tunde Bakare（下午 1:24）
還有一件事。有幾位客人問，不參加活動的話能不能買簽名書。

Rosa Calvo（下午 1:27）
Petrova 女士已經答應活動結束後多簽一些書。把他們的名字列成一張清單，我們會把書保留在前面的櫃台。

Mei Takahashi（下午 1:30）
那我在收銀台旁邊貼個告示，讓大家知道。
